newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Higher volumes, prices boost ASM Litho.
newsitem.headline: Higher volumes, prices boost ASM Litho.

text.p: Semiconductor equipment maker ASM Lithography NV said on Thursday a 45 percent rise in 1996 revenue to 1.33 billion guilders reflected increases both in the volume of sales and in average selling prices versus 1995.
ASM Litho said it sold 205 wafer steppers in 1996, up from 177 in 1995. It did not quantify the rise in selling prices.
Wafer steppers are photolithography projection systems which are used to manufacture semiconductors.
ASM Litho said its gross margin as a percentage of sales, rose to 40.1 percent in 1996 from 36.6 percent in 1995 as a result of a shift in product mix and a stronger dollar.
It said its operating margin increased to 25.2 percent from 22.8 percent in 1995 and that equity as a percentage of its assets now exceeded 60 percent.

ASM Litho said that while growth in net sales in 1996 was lower than the 60 percent compound annual growth rate achieved during the previous four years, it was nevertheless pleased that its results had continued to grow in both halves of the year.

ASM Litho's shares are listed in Amsterdam and on Nasdaq. Philips Electronics currently holds a 35.4 percent stake in ASM Litho but plans to reduce this to 23.9 percent by means of a public offering of 3.95 million shares.
